title: VividVanilla Shaders
description: A vibrant, saturated look for Minecraft that stays lightweight and true to the classic vanilla style.
body:
VividVanilla is designed for players who love the core look of Minecraft but want the colors to absolutely pop without destroying their frame rate. If you want a world that feels more alive, warm, and colorful—all while keeping things lightweight and performance-friendly—this is the shader pack for you.

By pulling out the rich hues of vanilla textures and boosting the environment's saturation, your biomes will look more lush, your oceans more inviting, and your builds more striking.
